title: HandyVision
summary: A real-time web app that detects and reads hand gestures via webcam using Python, OpenCV, Flask, and MediaPipe. The only SDV-family evidence is a coincidental substring 'sdv' inside an unrelated conda build path in requirements.txt, with no actual SDV dependency or usage.
evidence: requirements.txt: 'more-itertools @ file:///.../abs_e2687gwsdv/...' -- 'sdv' is part of a random temp folder name, not the library
